summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan visit a small house in Shinano village, Nagano Prefecture, that is surrounded by a beautiful forest called the "Soothing Forest". There, they meet a group of people who sell things and use ledgers, led by a village head. While everyone is doing chores, the village head is found dead, and everyone has an alibi, but Conan solves the case.

suspects: Shiro Murakami, Kinji Tateshiba, and Aiko Misawa
suspectsZh: 村上史郎、立芝金二与三泽爱子
